title: Jet-engine Honda car driven to Los Alamos
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico; El Mirage Dry Lake, California

tellings.quote: took my wife's little Honda, built a jet engine from scratch and

plain: In 1982, Bob Lazar says, he took his wife's little Honda, built a jet engine for it 'from scratch', and drove the car to Los Alamos, the New Mexico weapons laboratory, with El Mirage Dry Lake in California also part of the story. Lazar tells this to Michels about himself, as a sign of the kind of hands-on engineer he was.
